svg.title: Three training orders with the same NTP data and 3,000 RL updates

cc:Work.dc:title: Three training orders with the same NTP data and 3,000 RL updates
cc:Work.dc:description: Three schedules on one axis. Baseline: NTP A, then NTP B, then 3,000 RL updates. Direct continuation: NTP A, then 1,500 RL updates, then NTP B starting from the RL checkpoint, then 1,500 RL updates. Traces: NTP A, then 1,500 RL updates, then NTP B with the correct rollouts of that RL stage mixed in, then 1,500 RL updates. All three end after the same NTP data and 3,000 RL updates.
